Layout & Structure (Desktop 1440px):
1. Breadcrumbs: Home / Courses / Advanced Excel Masterclass with subtle chevron separators and clean hover states.

2. Two-column Grid (Layout):
LEFT MAIN COLUMN (approx 68% width):
- Category Badge: 'DATA & FINANCIAL MODELING' in subtle indigo pill + Level Badge ('Intermediate' in amber badge).
- Course Title: 'Advanced Excel Masterclass' (text-3xl / text-4xl font-extrabold text-slate-900).
- Subtitle: 'From spreadsheet basics to automation-grade Excel for analysts' (text-lg text-slate-600 font-normal mt-2 leading-relaxed).
- Meta Info Bar:
  * Rating: 4.8 stars (amber-400 SVG stars) with '(1,240 reviews)'
  * Enrolled: 8,420 students
  * Level: Intermediate
  * Duration & Lessons: 32 hours on-demand video • 96 lessons
  * Last updated: Updated October 2024 • English • Subtitles in English & Spanish
  * Lead Instructor: 'CA Rohan Mehta' with verified badge icon

- Promo Video Player block:
  * High-res modern dark financial dashboard/Excel spreadsheet video preview frame with rounded-xl border.
  * Central pulse play button with indigo backdrop & white triangle.
  * Overlay duration badge 'Preview this course (4:15 min)'.

- Sticky / Clean Course Sub-navigation Tabs:
  * 'Overview' (Active, bold indigo indicator line), 'Curriculum', 'Instructor', 'Reviews', 'FAQ'.

- Section: Overview Content:
  * 'What you'll learn' container: Slate-50 background container with rounded-xl border, 2-column grid of 8 checklist items with green SVG checkmark icons:
    1. Master advanced dynamic lookup formulas (XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH-MATCH, CHOOSE, OFFSET)
    2. Build automated multi-table financial models with dynamic scenarios and sensitivity tables
    3. Cleanse, transform, and merge disparate messy ERP datasets via Power Query M-code
    4. Implement advanced Pivot Tables, calculated fields, slicers, and interactive timeline filters
    5. Design executive-ready KPI dashboards following corporate visual hierarchy principles
    6. Automate repetitive workflow routines and report generation with recording & VBA scripts
    7. Leverage array formulas, FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, and LAMBDA custom functions
    8. Audit formulas, handle complex nesting errors, and optimize massive calculation workbooks
  
  * 'Skills you'll gain' tag chips:
    [XLOOKUP] [SUMIFS & Array Formulas] [Power Query ETL] [Pivot Tables & Slicers] [Dashboard Design] [Scenario Modeling] [Data Cleansing] [VBA Macros]
  
  * Detailed Description:
    Clear paragraphs explaining how this course bridges the gap between basic spreadsheet use and Wall Street / Fortune 500-grade financial analysis and enterprise operations.
  
  * Prerequisites & Target Audience (2-column mini cards):
    - Prerequisites: Basic knowledge of Excel navigation, familiarity with basic math functions (+, -, SUM, AVERAGE), Excel 2019/365 installed.
    - Who this course is for: Financial analysts, data practitioners, accountants, business operations managers, and aspiring consultants seeking rapid career progression.

- Section: Curriculum Content ('Course Content'):
  * Summary line: '4 sections • 24 modules • 96 total lessons • 32h 15m total length' with 'Expand all sections' button.
  * Accordion structure:
    - Section 1: 'Excel Fundamentals & Advanced Lookups' (Expanded state):
      * Sub-header: 6 lessons • 4h 30m
      * Lesson 1: 'Course Architecture, Data Files & Sandbox Setup' (12:40) - [Free Preview] indigo badge + Play icon
      * Lesson 2: 'Modern Dynamic Arrays & XLOOKUP vs Legacy VLOOKUP' (24:15) - [Free Preview] indigo badge + Play icon
      * Lesson 3: 'Nested INDEX/MATCH & Double-Axis Matrix Lookups' (38:20) - Lock icon
      * Lesson 4: 'FILTER, SORT, SORTBY, and UNIQUE in Practice' (29:10) - Lock icon
      * Lesson 5: 'Handling Missing Values and Complex IFERROR Nesting' (18:45) - Lock icon
      * Lesson 6: 'Section 1 Hands-on Capstone: Cohort Revenue Matrix' (45:00) - Lock icon + Resource file indicator
    - Section 2: 'Financial Modeling & Scenario Analysis' (Collapsed):
      * 8 lessons • 8h 15m • Sensitivity tables, Goal Seek, Solver, DCF model architecture.
    - Section 3: 'Power Query & Automated ETL Workflows' (Collapsed):
      * 10 lessons • 11h 20m • Ingesting multi-folder CSVs, unpivoting data, custom M parameters.
    - Section 4: 'Executive Dashboard Design & Capstone Projects' (Collapsed):
      * 8 lessons • 8h 10m • C-Suite presentation formatting, KPI cards, interactive UI controls.

- Section: Instructor Dossier:
  * Card featuring instructor photo (professional headshot of CA Rohan Mehta in corporate suit), Name: 'CA Rohan Mehta', Title: 'Principal Financial Architect & Ex-Deloitte Strategy Lead'.
  * Stats row: 4.9 Instructor Rating, 42,000+ Students, 6 Specialized Courses, 14 Years Industry Experience.
  * Bio paragraph highlighting his enterprise background building institutional modeling systems and advising global equity desks.

- Section: Student Reviews & Feedback:
  * Aggregate breakdown: Big 4.8 / 5.0 score with 5-star visual rating, 1,240 verified reviews.
  * Visual rating distribution progress bars (5-star 84%, 4-star 12%, 3-star 3%, 2-star 1%, 1-star 0%).
  * 3 Detailed Alumni Review cards:
    - Review 1: 'Sarah Jenkins, Senior Financial Analyst at McKinsey' - 'The XLOOKUP and Power Query workflow modules alone saved my team 15+ hours weekly. The capstone modeling template is identical to what we use on live engagements.'
    - Review 2: 'David Kalu, FP&A Lead' - 'Clear, structured, zero fluff. The breakdown of dynamic arrays and scenario matrices made complex model audits second nature.'
    - Review 3: 'Elena Rostova, Business Intelligence Consultant' - 'Rohan explains edge cases that traditional tutorials ignore. Best corporate Excel course on the market.'

- Section: FAQ Accordion:
  * 4 frequently asked questions with clean open/close toggles (prerequisites, live mentor support, certificate validity for corporate reimbursement, lifetime access).

RIGHT STICKY SIDEBAR (Purchase Card / Enrollment Panel):
- Floating sticky card (top-24) with border, subtle shadow, rounded-xl, bg-white, overflow-hidden:
  * Course visual header preview banner with Excel ribbon/formula badge graphic.
  * Pro Subscription Tag: 'Included in BICE Enterprise All-Access or Buy Individually'.
  * Pricing:
    - Large current price: '$49' (or ₹4,999) with strike-through '$99' (or ₹9,999)
    - Badge: '50% OFF' in red/rose badge + '2 days left at this price!' countdown urgency.
  * CTA Buttons:
    - Full-width primary button: 'Enroll Now' (indigo-600, font-semibold, py-3.5, rounded-lg, shadow-sm).
    - Full-width secondary button: 'Add to Wishlist' (with heart icon, border-slate-200, hover:bg-slate-50).
  * Guarantee: '30-Day Money-Back Guarantee • Full Refund No Questions Asked' with shield icon.
  * 'This course includes' checklist with Lucide-style line icons:
    - 32 hours on-demand HD video
    - 96 downloadable corporate models (.xlsx, .pbix)
    - 4 real-world capstone projects
    - Verified Certificate of Completion
    - Access on Mobile, Table
